data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 大教堂圣光下的拟态之剑誓约
data.description: 高耸入云的哥特大教堂内，伊莉娜身着教会圣天使战衣，手中拟态之剑散发灿烂光芒，阳光透过彩绘花窗在她身上织就斑斓圣衣。
data.location: 宏伟哥特式大教堂圣坛前
data.action: 双手握紧光芒长剑竖于胸前，神情庄严虔诚，双马尾在上升气流中轻扬
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃透下的多色丁达尔圣光光束，神圣光芒流转于剑刃
data.camera: 正面仰视中景，构图庄严对称，极具仪式感
data.promptProse: Irina Shidou stands valiantly before the altar of a colossal Gothic cathedral, bathed in brilliant polychromatic light streaming through stained glass windows. Clad in her form-fitting white-and-gold Church combat bodysuit, she holds her glowing sacred light blade upright before her chest in solemn prayer. Her chestnut twin-tails stir gently in the sanctified updraft, her amber eyes shining with resolute faith.
data.animaCaption: Holding her radiant holy blade aloft in front of the cathedral altar, Irina stands resolute beneath beams of stained glass light.
